Based on verified PIT Jaunpur campus records:

• **Hacktoberfest Hack Day Jaunpur 2026 Official Guide** (Hackathons):
  Hacktoberfest Hack Day Jaunpur 2026 **Date:** Saturday, 24 October 2026 **Timing:** 9:30 AM to 3:00 PM IST **Location:** Seminar Hall & Computer Center, Block B, Prasad Institute of Technology (PIT), Jaunpur, Uttar Pradesh. [Source: Hacktoberfest Hack Day Jaunpur 2026 Official Guide]

• **Hacktoberfest Hack Day Jaunpur 2026 Official Guide** (Hackathons):
  Schedule - 09:30 AM – 10:00 AM: Check-in, Badge Collection & Welcome Breakfast - 10:00 AM – 10:30 AM: Opening Keynote & Challenge Briefing (Gemma 4 & MLH Tracks) - 10:30 AM – 01:00 PM: Hacking Phase 1 & Mentor Round 1 - 01:00 PM – 01:45 PM: Free Networking Lunch & Refreshments (Cafeteria Lawn) - 01:45 PM – 02:45 PM: Ha... [Source: Hacktoberfest Hack Day Jaunpur 2026 Official Guide]

• **Hacktoberfest Hack Day Jaunpur 2026 Official Guide** (Hackathons):
  Sponsor Challenges & Free Perks - **Google Gemma Challenge:** Build applications leveraging Gemma 4 (gemma-4-31b-it / gemma-4-26b-a4b-it) via Google AI Studio free tier. - **Best Open-Source AI Project:** Rewarding modularity, clean code, documentation, and MIT open-source licensing. [Source: Hacktoberfest Hack Day Jaunpur 2026 Official Guide]

*(Grounded via local retrieval. For live neural Gemma 4 inference, add a free GEMINI_API_KEY from Google AI Studio in .env.local)*
